seo.title: How slow biplanes sank six battleships at Taranto
seo.description:
In 1940, 21 slow Fairey Swordfish biplanes launched a surprise Royal Navy attack on Taranto harbor. Admiral Andrew Cunningham's raid proved that massive battleship fleets were suddenly vulnerable to air power.

#NavalHistory #WorldWar2 #Taranto1940 #MilitaryHistory

Sources:
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Taranto
- https://www.airandspaceforces.com/article/the-air-raid-at-taranto
- https://nationalinterest.org/blog/reboot/taranto-nearly-forgotten-attack-inspired-pearl-harbor-172149
- https://www.usni.org/magazines/naval-history-magazine/1995/june/taranto
